hero.subtitle: Private flight for two | Approximately 40 minutes | Coordinated proposal

description.title: The Most Unforgettable Yes of Your Life
description.paragraph: A proposal coordinated from beginning to end: a private flight for two, a surprise banner with the big question, a bouquet of 24 roses, a toast, and full breakfast. Our team prepares every detail discreetly so you can focus on the moment.

steps.title: 5:00 AM - Arrive & Check-in
steps.description: You’ll arrive at Flying Pictures Reception, where our team will welcome you and help you complete check-in.

steps.title: Welcome & Coffee Break
steps.description: After you complete your check-in we will welcome you with our coffee station with hot beverages and traditional cookies.

steps.title: The Inflation Spectacle
steps.description: Walk to the launch field to watch the "Giants" come to life. Seeing the massive balloons rise with the roar of the burners is the first act of the show.

steps.title: The Ascent
steps.description: Lift off gently into the dawn. For approx. 45-60 minutes, float silently over the Valley of Teotihuacán, watching the sun reveal the pyramids from above.

steps.title: The 1783 Toast
steps.description: Upon landing, we celebrate with a traditional sparkling wine toast. A ritual dating back to the first aviators to thank the wind gods for a safe return.

included: Private flight of approximately 40 minutes for two adults
Coffee break with cookies and a tasting of traditional Mexican drinks
Sparkling-wine toast or a non-alcoholic option
Surprise banner reading Will you marry me?
notIncluded: Transport between Mexico City and Teotihuacán
French champagne — the included toast uses sparkling wine
Admission, transport, or guide for the archaeological zone
recommendedExtras: Photos and video during the flight
Admission and transport to the archaeological zone
notes: The base price of $11,500 MXN covers two adults on a private flight.
Photos and video are treated as an extra until the commercial team confirms otherwise.

steps.title: Arrive at the Globoport
steps.description: We welcome you with coffee while the team keeps the surprise discreet.

steps.title: Your balloon, just for you
steps.description: Board a private basket prepared for the occasion.

steps.title: Begin your private flight
steps.description: The pilot takes off when weather conditions are suitable.

steps.title: See the big question
steps.description: The team displays the surprise Will you marry me? banner.

steps.title: Receive the bouquet and toast
steps.description: We welcome you with 24 roses and a sparkling-wine toast.

steps.title: Enjoy breakfast
steps.description: Continue the celebration with a full breakfast at a local restaurant.

steps.title: Receive your certificates
steps.description: Take home personalised certificates as a memento of the experience.
